# Preserve native label targets and decorative icon semantics in Appearance

The fixed accepted Appearance controls use label control attributes for defaultViewFlags and defaultSortType, a radiogroup for threading, and localized child radios. The category icon has an empty alt value and a separate localized category label. Keep those control and name relationships when changing the pane. The historical threading control was a menulist; prefer the current structure for this pane. This is structural accessibility evidence only; focus order, speech, contrast and hit areas were not tested. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / components.
